games.name: [UPD] Soulrift
games.desc:
Step into a realm between heaven and hell.. A purgatory where only the most godlike beings are bound. This is a round-based boss fighting game where every encounter tests nothing but your skill. 

Fight a variety of bosses, each with their own unique attack patterns, mechanics, and fight-defining gimmicks.

Unlock and play as a diverse roster of characters, each with their own abilities, specialties, and playstyles.

Contain them all. Your job starts now.

CONTROLS (Keybinds are changeable in settings)
- Left Click: M1
- Q: Dash
- Z: Ability 1
- X: Ability 2
- C: Ability 3

games.name: [🎣] Gone Hunting
games.desc:
🦌 Welcome to Gone Hunting 🎣

Update 4 ✨
● NEW AREA! The Rainveil Forest! 🐍
● New Grappler, Gear, Animals, and More!

Hunt and fish your way through a relaxing RPG adventure. Explore a living world with dynamic weather, rare catches, and skill-based challenges.

✨ Features
• Hunting rifle minigame – accuracy matters, aim for the middle!
• Unique fishing system – tap fast to reel in your catch!
• Passive trapping – earn even while offline!
• 8 dynamic weather types that change spawns & maps!
• Stack up weather traits to get the most valuable animals!

🎮 How To Play
• Equip your rifle, rod, or traps from your gear inventory
• Explore the map to find animals and fishing spots
• Complete minigames to secure your catch
• Sell your finds, upgrade gear, and get the most rare animals!

games.name: Build a Car to Kill Zombies
games.desc:
Get ready for a fun adventure in Build a car to kill zombies! 🧟‍♀️
Build your own awesome car to take on the silly zombie invasion! Use blocks, bumpers, and tough wheels to create a super cool vehicle 🚚

Attach powerful weapons and zoom through wild obstacles while squashing goofy zombies! Deliver special items to checkpoints to unlock even more unique blocks and exciting upgrades.

Join the fun, show off your building skills, and let’s see if you can create the ultimate zombie fighting machine! The adventure awaits, so let’s hit the road and save the day!

games.name: [BANS] Make an Error
games.desc:
😵 Welcome to Make an Error! (formerly Untitled Error Creator)

Type anything, style it your way, fool your friends, or just be funny!

⚙️ HOW TO MAKE AN ERROR:
• Click the Create Error button at the bottom
• Fill in your title, message, code, and buttons
• Hit the blue Play button to see it in action!

🎨 HOW TO SWITCH ERROR STYLES:
• Press Create Error
• At the bottom right, click the Styles button
• Choose your favorite look, like our brand new Ban style!
• Swap styles anytime to test them all out!

✨ FEATURES:
• 🔠 Custom titles
• 💬 Editable messages
• ⚠️ Fake error codes
• ☑️ Button text editing
• 👥 Share with other players
• 💾 Save and load your errors anytime
